== Description ==

Players at a table in the tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, including [[Steve Harpster]] (front left, black jacket and white hair) and [[Mark Billings]] (back centre-left, ponytail and glasses); other players unlabeled.
